project_info.theme: 48-hour final push for AI business arena

main_subject.detail: A warm brown 3D mascot poster with VBI Academy, FTU, and Techcombank logos. Large centered text says '48 gio cuoi tiep suc tai nang but pha'. A rounded cream pill below reads 'Vong 2 - The NextX - Dau Truong A.I Kinh Doanh'. At the bottom stand two cute white robot mascots with gold headphones and Techcombank chest marks; one gives a thumbs up and the other points at a small square sign with a heart icon. Transparent futuristic interface panels float in the background.
main_subject.style: Friendly 3D mascot campaign poster with warm premium-tech mood and soft edtech visual language
